unitTitle: The Python Hunt - Episode 1: Do not Disturb
scanNote:
2-HIKOYA, 1-QISM (68-bet). KOMIKS shaklidagi bet.

Yuqorida chapda TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq harflar: kasseta belgisi va 'Episode 1', ostida 'Do not Disturb'. O'ngda katta SARIQ bo'rtma harflar 'The Python Hunt'.

Kirish (qiya): 'Sandra and David are in Cameroon, West Africa, to write about a python hunter.'

YETTI KADR:
1-KADR: Kamerun xaritasi (Ngaoundéré, Yaoundé shaharlari), pastda Afrika qit'asi, Kamerun belgilangan.
2-KADR: Yashil jip oldida David (qora sochli, sariq ko'ylak) va Sandra (sariq sochli); ikki afrikalik erkak - Abou (yosh) va Adamou (otasi). Pufakchalar: "Hello! I'm David and this is Sandra. Are you the python hunters?" / "Yes - I'm Abou, and this is my father, Adamou. He's been hunting pythons for thirty years."
3-KADR: Sandra va Abou. Pufakchalar: "Aren't pythons dangerous, Abou? Why do you hunt them?" / "Well, they aren't poisonous, but they are big, and strong enough to kill you! We hunt them for their meat and their beautiful skins."
4-KADR: David fotoapparat bilan, Abou yerdagi teshikni ko'rsatmoqda, Adamou tiz cho'kkan. Pufakcha (Abou): "Can you see these marks on the ground? They show there's a python inside the hole. My father is going to go down and pull it out."
5-KADR: Sandra so'raydi, David suratga olmoqda, Adamou qo'liga teri o'ramoqda. Pufakchalar: "What's your father doing, Abou?" / "He's covering his arm with animal skin, like a glove. Pythons have got long, sharp teeth, and they bite!"
6-KADR: David teshik ichiga kirib fotoapparat bilan chiroq yoritmoqda, Abou tepada. Pufakchalar (David): 'I want to take pictures of the snake inside its hole, before Adamou catches it.' / (Abou): "Be careful, David! Don't get too close to the python!"
7-KADR: Teshikdan 'HELP!!' qichqirig'i, Abou Davidning oyog'idan tortmoqda, Sandra qo'rqib turibdi. Pufakcha (Abou): 'Quick, Sandra! Help me pull him out!'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '68'.

exercises.instructionEn: Sandra and David are in Cameroon, West Africa, to write about a python hunter.
exercises.instructionUz: Sandra va David G'arbiy Afrikadagi Kamerunda piton ovchisi haqida yozish uchun kelishgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
YANGI HIKOYa - 'PITON OVI'.

  ⚠ Sandra va David - 'The Shark
  Caller' hikoyasidagi muxbirlar
  (24-25, 46-47-betlar). Endi
  Kamerunda.


⚠ 'DO NOT DISTURB':

  = bezovta qilmang.
  ⚠ Mehmonxona eshigidagi yozuv.
  ⚠ Bu yerda: pitonni bezovta
  qilmang!


⚠ 'A PYTHON':

  = piton (katta ilon).
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈpaɪθən/.
  ⚠ Zaharsiz, lekin bo'g'ib
  o'ldiradi.


⚠ 'A HUNT' / 'TO HUNT':

  = ov / ovlamoq.
  ⚠ 'a hunter' = ovchi.


⚠ 'CAMEROON':

  = Kamerun (G'arbiy Afrika).
  Poytaxti - Yaoundé.


⚠ QISM QISQAChA:

  Abou va otasi Adamou - piton
  ovchilari. Adamou pitonni
  teshikdan tortib chiqarmoqchi.
  David suratga olish uchun teshikka
  kiradi - va 'HELP!!' deb
  qichqiradi. Davomi 69-70-betlarda.


⚠ GRAMMATIKA HIKOYaDA:

  present perfect continuous: "He's
     been hunting pythons for thirty
     years"
  'enough': 'strong ENOUGH to kill
     you' (10-unit mavzusi)
  buyruq mayli: 'Be careful!',
     "Don't get too close!" (10-unit
     mavzusi)
  'too': 'TOO close' (10-unit)

points.en: [2] David: Hello! I'm David and this is Sandra. Are you the python hunters? — Abou: Yes - I'm Abou, and this is my father, Adamou. He's been hunting pythons for thirty years.
points.uz: [2] David: Salom! Men Davidman, bu Sandra. Siz piton ovchilarimisiz? — Abou: Ha - men Abouman, bu esa otam Adamou. U o'ttiz yildan beri piton ovlaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "He's been hunting" - present perfect
continuous + 'for thirty years'.
⚠ 'this is' - tanishtirish.

points.en: [3] Sandra: Aren't pythons dangerous, Abou? Why do you hunt them? — Abou: Well, they aren't poisonous, but they are big, and strong enough to kill you! We hunt them for their meat and their beautiful skins.
points.uz: [3] Sandra: Pitonlar xavfli emasmi, Abou? Nega ularni ovlaysizlar? — Abou: Ular zaharli emas, lekin katta va sizni o'ldirishga yetarli darajada kuchli! Biz ularni go'shti va chiroyli terisi uchun ovlaymiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "Aren't pythons dangerous?" - inkor savol =
'xavfli-ku, to'g'rimi?'
⚠ 'poisonous' = zaharli.
⚠ 'strong ENOUGH to' = ... ga yetarli kuchli.

points.en: [4] Abou: Can you see these marks on the ground? They show there's a python inside the hole. My father is going to go down and pull it out.
points.uz: [4] Abou: Yerdagi bu izlarni ko'ryapsizmi? Ular teshik ichida piton borligini ko'rsatadi. Otam pastga tushib uni tortib chiqaradi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a mark' = iz, belgi.
⚠ 'to pull out' = tortib chiqarmoq.
⚠ 'is going to' - niyat.

points.en: [5] Sandra: What's your father doing, Abou? — Abou: He's covering his arm with animal skin, like a glove. Pythons have got long, sharp teeth, and they bite!
points.uz: [5] Sandra: Otang nima qilyapti, Abou? — Abou: U qo'lini hayvon terisi bilan qo'lqopdek o'rayapti. Pitonlarning uzun, o'tkir tishlari bor va ular tishlaydi!
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to cover with' = ... bilan qoplamoq.
⚠ 'a glove' = qo'lqop.
⚠ 'sharp' = o'tkir; 'to bite' = tishlamoq.

points.en: [6] David: I want to take pictures of the snake inside its hole, before Adamou catches it. — Abou: Be careful, David! Don't get too close to the python!
points.uz: [6] David: Adamou uni tutishidan oldin ilonni teshik ichida suratga olmoqchiman. — Abou: Ehtiyot bo'l, David! Pitonga juda yaqin borma!
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'before Adamou CATCHES' - present simple.
⚠ 'Be careful!' / "Don't get too close!" -
BUYRUQ MAYLI (10-unit).
⚠ 'too close' = juda yaqin.

points.en: [7] David: HELP!! — Abou: Quick, Sandra! Help me pull him out!
points.uz: [7] David: YORDAM!! — Abou: Tez, Sandra! Uni tortib chiqarishga yordam ber!

thirty years."

skins'.

big, and strong enough to kill you".
